title: A growable ring deque
hints: Step `head_` backwards with `(head_ + capacity - 1) % capacity`: adding `capacity` first keeps the unsigned number from going below zero.
In `grow`, read the old elements through `slot(i)` for `i` from 0 to `size_ - 1`; that unrolls the wrap-around, so in the new vector they sit in order from slot 0.
